MANUAL A/C DIAGNOSIS
TSB Revision
HEATING AND AIR CONDITIONING
55-8
STEP 8. Check the refrigerant-temperature switch 
operation.
When the A/C is off, check that there is less than 2 ohm 
between the refrigerant-temperature switch terminals. 
Q: Is the refrigerant-temperature switch in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 9.
NO : If the switch has an open circuit, replace the switch. 
Then go to Step 11.
STEP 9. Measure the automatic compressor controller 
terminal voltage.
Refer to P.55-18.
Q: Is the automatic compressor controller terminal voltage 
good?
YES : Go to Step 10.
NO : Replace. Then go to Step 11.
STEP 10. Measure the engine control module <M/T>/the 
powertrain control module <A/T> terminal voltage.
Refer to GROUP 13A, Diagnosis − Check at the Engine Control 
Module (ECM) <M/T> or Powertrain Control Module (PCM) <A/
T> <2.4L engine> P.13A-452.
Refer to GROUP 13B, Diagnosis − Check at the Engine Control 
Module (ECM) <M/T> or Powertrain Control Module (PCM) <A/
T> <3.0L engine> P.13B-531.
Q: Is the terminal voltage in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 11.
NO : Replace. Then go to Step 11.
STEP 11. Check symptoms.
Q: Is the A/C operating properly?
YES : This diagnosis is complete. (If no malfunctions are not 
found in all steps, an intermittent malfunction is 
suspected. Refer to GROUP 00E, How to Use 
Troubleshooting/Inspection Service Points − How to 
Cope with Intermittent Malfunction P.00-6.)
NO : Go to Step 1.
